reviews.review: The game in principle is a lot of fun; however, it is not a casual experience unless you play on the easier difficulty modes.  Also, this game requires you to play in a full squad and if you match make you are largely dependent on whomever you get joining or you are joining yourself.  I don't think this game is bad, but I have a huge problem with how the developers of this game are approaching this game.  it is plagued with issues between what the players want and what the developers intend to implement.  I couldn't tell you how often the devs screwed up big time delivering on what the players wanted and the constant back and forth between them.  It also doesn't help that Sony is too big for its own good and just further messes with the harmony with the community and the devs.  The best way I see this game right now is how the relationship with the players and the developers were with The Division and frankly lost interest because I don't care to watch parties argue about whatever issue it may be.  I game to relax and enjoy myself and I find there is more drama with this game than anything else I do in my life...

the game is amazing and i am loving the current direction its going with the new campaigns as well as loving the free items we can get from them such as the new FRV. The only thing that i am a bit sad with the with constant appearance of a bug in which either people can hear me and i cant hear them or vise versa as well as not being able to hear each other at all which appeared again after the latest patch. At this point i believe that it is something with the actual game and not on my end but i am not sure as sometimes it will get fixed if we just reset the game while other times it wont. If anybody has an idea about how to fix it it would be great but i would still recommend the game as it is still amazing to play with friends even if i cant hear them lol.
